sections.heading: Get your Medical product EMI/EMC
paragraphs: At ITC India Pvt Ltd, we specialize in EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) and EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) testing, offering world-class services tailored for medical equipment manufacturers. With increasing regulations and technological complexity in the healthcare sector, ensuring electromagnetic safety and compliance is not just mandatory—it’s critical.
Whether you’re launching a new medical device or entering new global markets, we help you meet international standards such as IEC 60601, CISPR 11, FCC Part 18, and ISO 14971.

sections.heading: ✅ Our EMI/EMC Testing Capabilities
paragraphs: All testing is conducted in our state-of-the-art anechoic chambers equipped with the latest equipment, operated by NABL-accredited engineers.
